notes: Median ~1017 foci/nucleus is biologically plausible for Brd4 and the montage shows dense, nucleoplasm-filling puncta with good spatial coverage excluding the nucleolus, consistent with expectation. However, several detected objects appear oversized/irregular (blobs spanning multiple true puncta, suggesting some merging), while a minority of very small fragments may represent noise-level over-splitting; a modest increase in threshold and minimum object size would consolidate merged blobs and suppress noise without substantially reducing the true count.
